_comment: Hand-maintained: who runs a shop's checkout. 'hosted' = a cart service runs the shop and its checkout; 'self' = shop software the site installs and runs itself. 'name' is the webappanalyzer technology name. A product needs two different kinds of trace (e.g. a script and a meta tag) by default, because one generic trace can appear on pages that are not the shop (BASE's own site links to shops; any page can embed a BigCommerce image). 'singleTraceReason' allows one kind, only when every trace of that product's fingerprint comes from the shop itself — say why. Add a product only when its kind is clear, with its source.

platforms.name: stores.jp
platforms.singleTraceReason: its only trace is the STORES_JP global, set by the storefront

platforms.name: MakeShop
platforms.singleTraceReason: MakeShop_* globals and gigaplus.makeshop.jp assets are served only to MakeShop shops

platforms.name: ColorMeShop
platforms.singleTraceReason: its only trace is the Colorme global, set by the storefront

platforms.name: Future Shop
platforms.singleTraceReason: its only trace is future-shop.*.js, loaded by futureshop storefronts

platforms.name: Wix eCommerce
platforms.singleTraceReason: its direct trace is the wixstores app in the page's Wix viewer model

platforms.name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
platforms.singleTraceReason: Demandware headers, cookies and static paths come from the storefront itself

platforms.name: EC-CUBE
platforms.singleTraceReason: its only trace is EC-CUBE's own eccube.js / win_op.js

platforms.name: Magento
platforms.singleTraceReason: Magento cookies, Mage globals and static paths come from the running install

platforms.name: WooCommerce
platforms.singleTraceReason: requires WordPress and matches WooCommerce's own runtime assets and cookies

platforms.name: PrestaShop
platforms.singleTraceReason: PrestaShop headers, cookies and module paths come from the running install

platforms.name: OpenCart
platforms.singleTraceReason: the OCSESSID cookie and OpenCart theme paths come from the running install

platforms.name: Welcart
platforms.singleTraceReason: requires WordPress and matches Welcart's own usces assets and cookies

platforms.name: Zen Cart
platforms.singleTraceReason: its only trace is Zen Cart's generator meta tag

platforms.name: osCommerce
platforms.singleTraceReason: the osCsid session and osCommerce markup come from the running install
